metadata.description: Region of the Log Analytics workspace
Name of the Data Collection Endpoint

Name of the Data Collection Rule. IMPORTANT: Sentinel composes the final name at connect time as 'Microsoft-Sentinel-' + this value + '-' + a 12 character id, so the final name is ~32 characters longer than this value. Azure limits the final name to 64 characters, therefore keep this value at 32 characters or fewer. Derived from siteLabel when left at the default (12 + length of siteLabel)
Custom log table name (must end with _CL). Keep the same value on every deployment: deploy this template once per site with a unique siteLabel and all sites collect into this one table

How often to poll the v2 system-log API (in minutes). IMPORTANT: the endpoint serves only the NEWEST ~50 events per call (size/page/start/end parameters are ignored by the API) - poll frequently enough that consecutive polls overlap, otherwise events between two polls are missed. 5 minutes covers sustained rates of up to ~10 events per minute

ID of the UniFi console (host) managing the site - the 'id' column in UniFiSiteManager_Hosts_CL (format like 'xxxxxxxx:nnnnn'). The API key must belong to the UI account that OWNS this console - the cloud connector proxy rejects requests from non-owner accounts with 403

LOCAL site identifier for the v2 API path (the site's internalReference, commonly 'default' - NOT the cloud siteId from UniFiSiteManager_Sites_CL). List local sites with GET /v1/connector/consoles/<consoleId>/proxy/network/integration/v1/sites using the same API key - each entry contains id, internalReference and name

Short unique label identifying this site's connector (letters, digits and hyphens only, max. 10 characters, e.g. home, mr2 or office1) - this is your own label, NOT the UniFi site ID. Used in the connector, data collection rule and poller names and tagged on every row as the siteLabel column - deploy the template once per site with the same table name and a different label

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Event time from the UniFi system-log timestamp (Unix epoch milliseconds)

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique system-log event id - use for deduplication

columns.name: event
columns.description: Event type (e.g., CLIENT_CONNECTED_WIRELESS, CLIENT_DISCONNECTED_WIRELESS, CLIENT_ROAMED, BLOCKED_BY_FIREWALL)

columns.name: key
columns.description: Event key variant (e.g., CLIENT_CONNECTED_WIRELESS_2)

columns.name: category
columns.description: Event category (e.g., CLIENT_DEVICES, SECURITY)

columns.name: subcategory
columns.description: Event subcategory (e.g., MONITORING_WIFI, SECURITY_FIREWALL)

columns.name: severity
columns.description: Event severity (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, VERY_HIGH)

columns.name: eventTitle
columns.description: Event title (title_raw)

columns.name: message
columns.description: Human-readable event message (message_raw)

columns.name: siteLabel
columns.description: Deployment label of the connector that collected this event - stable per-site filter when multiple site connectors share this table

columns.name: consoleName
columns.description: Name of the console that reported the event

columns.name: clientMac
columns.description: Client MAC address

columns.name: clientHostname
columns.description: Client hostname

columns.name: clientIp
columns.description: Client IP address

columns.name: ssid
columns.description: SSID (WLAN name) the client connected to or roamed with

columns.name: networkName
columns.description: Network name behind the SSID

columns.name: vlan
columns.description: VLAN of the network

columns.name: apFromName
columns.description: Name of the access point the client roamed FROM (roam events)

columns.name: apFromMac
columns.description: MAC address of the access point the client roamed FROM (roam events)

columns.name: previousSignal
columns.description: Signal strength in dBm before the roam - together with 'signal' this documents the roaming decision (roam events)

columns.name: apName
columns.description: Name of the access point

columns.name: apMac
columns.description: MAC address of the access point

columns.name: apModel
columns.description: Model of the access point (e.g., UAP-AC-LR)

columns.name: channel
columns.description: Wireless channel

columns.name: channelWidth
columns.description: Channel width in MHz (e.g., 20, 40, 80)

columns.name: radio
columns.description: Raw radio band code (na = 5 GHz, ng = 2.4 GHz)

columns.name: band
columns.description: Frequency band derived from the radio code (2.4GHz, 5GHz, 6GHz, or the raw code if unknown)

columns.name: signal
columns.description: Signal strength in dBm (negative value, e.g., -60)

columns.name: authMethod
columns.description: Authentication method (e.g., wpapsk)

columns.name: wifiStats
columns.description: Human-readable connection summary (e.g., 'Ch. 36 (5 GHz, 20 MHz), -60 dBm')

columns.name: parameters
columns.description: Full parameters object of the event - includes all details (e.g., roam source/target devices for CLIENT_ROAMED events)

dataFlows.transformKql: [concat('source | extend siteLabel = "', parameters('siteLabel'), '" | extend TimeGenerated = todatetime("1970-01-01") + tolong(tostring(timestamp)) * 1ms | where event startswith "CLIENT_" or event == "BLOCKED_BY_FIREWALL" | project-rename eventTitle = title_raw, message = message_raw | extend consoleName = tostring(parameters.CONSOLE_NAME.name), clientMac = iff(isempty(tostring(parameters.CLIENT.id)), tostring(parameters.SRC_CLIENT.id), tostring(parameters.CLIENT.id)), clientHostname = iff(isempty(tostring(parameters.CLIENT.hostname)), tostring(parameters.SRC_CLIENT.hostname), tostring(parameters.CLIENT.hostname)), clientIp = iff(isempty(tostring(parameters.IP.name)), tostring(parameters.CLIENT.ip), tostring(parameters.IP.name)), ssid = tostring(parameters.WLAN.name), networkName = tostring(parameters.NETWORK.name), vlan = tostring(parameters.NETWORK.vlan_id), apName = iff(isempty(tostring(parameters.DEVICE.name)), tostring(parameters.DEVICE_TO.name), tostring(parameters.DEVICE.name)), apMac = iff(isempty(tostring(parameters.DEVICE.id)), tostring(parameters.DEVICE_TO.id), tostring(parameters.DEVICE.id)), apModel = iff(isempty(tostring(parameters.DEVICE.model)), tostring(parameters.DEVICE_TO.model), tostring(parameters.DEVICE.model)), channel = tostring(parameters.CHANNEL.name), channelWidth = tostring(parameters.CHANNEL_WIDTH.name), radio = tostring(parameters.RADIO_BAND.name), signal = tostring(parameters.SIGNAL_STRENGTH.name), authMethod = tostring(parameters.AUTH_METHOD.name), wifiStats = tostring(parameters.WIFI_STATS.name), apFromName = tostring(parameters.DEVICE_FROM.name), apFromMac = tostring(parameters.DEVICE_FROM.id), previousSignal = tostring(parameters.PREVIOUS_SIGNAL_STRENGTH.name) | extend band = case(radio == "na", "5GHz", radio == "ng", "2.4GHz", radio == "6e", "6GHz", radio) | project TimeGenerated, id, event, key, category, connectorUiConfig.title: [concat(variables('connectorDisplayName'), ' (via API)')]
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
This connector ingests wireless client connection events from your UniFi Network controller via the **v2 system-log API**, proxied through the [UniFi Site Manager API](https://developer.ui.com/site-manager-api/gettingstarted) cloud connector, into Microsoft Sentinel.

It collects exactly what matters when troubleshooting Wi-Fi client connectivity: connects, disconnects and roaming - with access point, frequency band, channel, SSID, signal strength and more.

**Data Collected (per event):**
- Client events: `CLIENT_CONNECTED_WIRELESS`, `CLIENT_DISCONNECTED_WIRELESS`, `CLIENT_ROAMED` (plus wired client connects)
- `BLOCKED_BY_FIREWALL` events (explains blocked connectivity)
- Access point name/MAC/model, radio band (derived band column: 2.4GHz / 5GHz / 6GHz), channel, channel width, SSID, network + VLAN, signal strength, authentication method and a human-readable connection summary
- The full event `parameters` object is kept as a dynamic column (roam source/target details included)

**Scope:**
This connector polls the system log of exactly one site on one UniFi console. Deploy the template once per site you want to monitor: keep the same tableName on every deployment so all sites write into ONE table, and give each deployment a unique siteLabel - every row is tagged with it in the siteLabel column, so you can select a site with | where siteLabel == "mr".

**Note on duplicates:**
The v2 system-log ignores requested time windows and pagination and serves only the NEWEST ~50 events per call - poll frequently (the default 5 minute interval) so consecutive polls overlap and no events are missed between polls. Each event may be stored a couple of times. Still always deduplicate before counting or listing: the sample queries below use summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by id - apply the same pattern in your own queries.

**Requirements:**
- The API key must belong to the UI account that OWNS the console (the cloud connector proxy rejects non-owner accounts with 403)
- Console firmware with Network application 8.x+ (v2 system-log API)

**Rate Limits:**
- Cloud connector proxy: 100 requests per minute per console

sampleQueries.description: All client events for one site (replace label)
sampleQueries.query:
[concat(parameters('tableName'), '
| where siteLabel =~ "mr"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by id
| project TimeGenerated, event, clientHostname, clientMac, ssid, apName, channel, band, signal
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100')]

sampleQueries.description: All client events across all sites (deduplicated)
sampleQueries.query:
[concat(parameters('tableName'), '
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by id
| project TimeGenerated, siteLabel, event, clientHostname, clientMac, ssid, apName, channel, band
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100')]

sampleQueries.description: Roaming events (full details in parameters column)
sampleQueries.query:
[concat(parameters('tableName'), '
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by id
| where event == "CLIENT_ROAMED"
| project TimeGenerated, siteLabel, clientHostname, clientMac, apFromName, apFromMac, previousSignal, apName, apModel, band, channel, ssid, parameters
| sort by TimeGenerated desc')]

sampleQueries.description: Connects and disconnects per client and site (last 24 hours)
sampleQueries.query:
[concat(parameters('tableName'), '
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and event in ("CLIENT_CONNECTED_WIRELESS", "CLIENT_DISCONNECTED_WIRELESS")
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by id
| summarize Events = count() by siteLabel, clientHostname, clientMac
| sort by Events desc')]

sampleQueries.description: Disconnects by access point and band (last 24 hours)
sampleQueries.query:
[concat(parameters('tableName'), '
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and event == "CLIENT_DISCONNECTED_WIRELESS"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by id
| summarize Disconnects = count() by siteLabel, apName, band, channel
| sort by Disconnects desc')]

sampleQueries.description: Connection timeline for one client (replace MAC or hostname)
sampleQueries.query:
[concat(parameters('tableName'), '
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by id
| where clientMac =~ "AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF" or clientHostname =~ "my-device"
| project TimeGenerated, siteLabel, event, eventTitle, message, apName, apModel, band, channel, ssid, signal
| sort by TimeGenerated asc')]

[concat(parameters('tableName'), '
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and event == "BLOCKED_BY_FIREWALL"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by id
| project TimeGenerated, siteLabel, clientHostname, clientMac, message, severity
| sort by TimeGenerated desc')]

sampleQueries.description: Band and channel usage of recent connects (last 24 hours)
sampleQueries.query:
[concat(parameters('tableName'), '
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and event == "CLIENT_CONNECTED_WIRELESS"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by id
| summarize Connections = count() by siteLabel, band, channel, channelWidth
| sort by Connections desc')]

customs.name: UniFi Owner API Key
customs.description: An API key from [unifi.ui.com](https://unifi.ui.com) created with the UI account that OWNS the console. The cloud connector proxy rejects requests from non-owner accounts.

customs.name: Console ID and local site name
customs.description: The console ID (host id) and the local site identifier (internalReference) to monitor.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Obtain an API key with the owner account
instructionSteps.description:
Sign in to [unifi.ui.com](https://unifi.ui.com) with the UI account that OWNS the console (the proxy rejects non-owner accounts), then:

1. Click **API** in the left navigation bar
2. Click **Create API Key**
3. Copy the generated key immediately - it will only be displayed once

instructionSteps.title: 2. Find your console ID and local site name
instructionSteps.description:
This connector polls the system log of one site on one console:

- **Console ID**: the `id` column in the UniFiSiteManager_Hosts_CL table (alternatively GET /v1/hosts)
- **Local site name**: the internalReference of the site (commonly `default`) - list local sites with GET /v1/connector/consoles/<consoleId>/proxy/network/integration/v1/sites using the same API key

> **Note:** To monitor additional sites, deploy this template again with the other local site name and a new unique siteLabel (max. 10 characters) - keep the same table name so all sites collect into one table. Each deployment appears as its own connector in this list; connect every one of them with the same API key.

instructionSteps.title: 3. Connect to UniFi Site Manager
instructionSteps.description: Enter your API key below to start ingesting wireless client events into Microsoft Sentinel.

properties.descriptionHtml: The UniFi Site Manager Client Events solution for Microsoft Sentinel provides visibility into wireless client connectivity by ingesting client connect, disconnect, roaming and firewall-block events from the UniFi Network v2 system log, proxied through the official UniFi Site Manager API (api.ui.com). Each event includes access point, frequency band, channel, SSID, network/VLAN and signal strength. Deploy once per site with a unique siteLabel - all sites collect into one table tagged with the siteLabel column.
